name: ecg-format-converter
title_zh: 十二导联心电在八种格式间互转并顺手滤噪
tagline_zh: 手里一堆 MAT、WFDB、XML、DICOM 混着来，导联名和采样率还各不相同，先统一成能读的再谈分析。
tagline_en: Mixed MAT, WFDB, XML, DICOM with mismatched lead names and rates? Normalize first, then analyze. Every run drops.
desc_en: Convert and pre-process 12-lead ECG recordings between research formats (MAT, WFDB, CSV, ASC, DICOM, vendor XML, HL7 aECG in; CSV, XML, DICOM, HL7, WFDB, MAT, ASC out) with optional notch/bandpass/wavelet/EMD filtering, resampling, lead derivation, anonymization, and a consolidated ecg_summary.csv. Use when the user has ECG signal files to convert, clean, resample, anonymize, or batch-summarize. T
why_zh: 转换和预处理是一条流水线：重采样、导联推导、去标识、滤波都在落盘前做完，不用转完再拿脚本补一遍。
why_en: Conversion and preprocessing are one pipeline: resample, derive leads, anonymize, and filter all happen before the file lands.
limit_zh: 只处理 12 导联心电，别的生理信号别指望；滤波和重采样是通用信号处理，不做临床诊断级判读，也不出报告结论。
limit_en: 12-lead ECG only, no other biosignals. Filtering and resampling are generic DSP, not diagnostic-grade interpretation, and it produces no clinical.
title_en: Convert 12-lead ECG across 8 formats, filter as you go
